origin.summary: The native weights are the unchanged Decision 1.0 Kai weights (byte-identical to the current main revision `9d6872cde6950c2c2b5786d182ec9a06ca1bdd66`); only the complete-input cap differs from the published 1,024-token profile.

runtime_requirements.torch: 2.12.0+git6bbd260 (ROCm build; CPU and one ROCm GPU tested)

runtime_equivalence: decision2/kai_native.py follows v2/06b/kai8k.py (sha256 6217914c4bfa5aebb053c53fb8ad8b9d1493ae8f5a89d2750828e625f6d79d07): the same System One conversion, admission, type-sorted native FP32 batches of eight and answer mapping, without the ROCm-only device assertion. Equivalence is checked against the sealed kai1-native-8k predictions by release.sh --parity.

components.component: Decision 1.0 Kai model weights, native code and documentation
Gemma-origin tokenizer material inherited through mmBERT

attributions: [Decision 1.0 Kai-0.6B](https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router/Decision-1.0-Kai-0.6B) at `7185f514f54b8f93c55998b1e8f9c5cc67f0d029`: direct weight origin (unchanged native weights) and the vendored native runtime (`decision2/_vendor`).

[Vela-1.0-Encoder-307M](https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router/Vela-1.0-Encoder-307M) and [mmBERT-base](https://huggingface.co/jhu-clsp/mmBERT-base): encoder lineage under the MIT terms retained in LICENSES/Upstream-MIT.txt; see NOTICE.
Adapted ModernBERT code from Transformers 4.57.6 under LICENSES/Transformers-Apache-2.0.txt.
Gemma-origin tokenizer material inherited through mmBERT, distributed with the Gemma terms in LICENSES/gemma/.
Owl banner: Decision 1.0 Kai mosaic owl, unchanged pixels, in a new DEV2.0 name layout; wordmark set in Poppins (SIL Open Font License) and DejaVu Sans Bold.
licensing_notes: The inherited tokenizer keeps the Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy in `LICENSES/gemma/`; this does not describe the encoder weights as Gemma weights. See `NOTICE` for the full component mapping.

card.requirements_text: Tested with Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.12 and Transformers 4.57.6; the native encoder requires exactly Transformers 4.57.6.

text.tagline: A compact bidirectional encoder for routing choices, yes/no checks and rubric scores over one state.
text.staging_notice: Private staging dry run of the Decision 2.0 release pipeline. The weights are the unchanged Decision 1.0 Kai weights served through the Decision 2.0 package runtime at an 8,192-token input cap. This is not a Decision 2.0 model and is not part of the Decision 2.0 collection.
limitations: Same weights as Decision 1.0 Kai: the only change is the 8,192-token complete-input cap (published Kai: 1,024 tokens), which lets longer public questions be answered.
